decisions.question: Discipline, comparative scope and qualifications
decisions.resolution: Retain the qualified claim about the needs of general language study, interconnection and structure; use continents consistently without asserting a common original language.

decisions.question: Aim and depth of inquiry
decisions.resolution: Preserve personal ability, due completeness and above-all priority; render Wesen as essential character locally, distinguishing Natur.

decisions.question: Study versus own treatment; manuscript resources
decisions.resolution: Preserve the contrast between studying and personally preparing treatments and the longer collecting period. Do not invent completed grammars, fieldwork or autograph-only manuscripts.

decisions.question: Limits of collecting
decisions.resolution: Preserve the impossibility of completeness and its inherence in the matter itself; the semicolon does not add an independent causal premise.

decisions.question: Sources, prior work and adequacy
decisions.resolution: Keep source resources distinct from the earlier work combined with them. Preserve abundant versus sufficient material and repeat the elided noun in English.
